text:
Welcome to the Perfume Pagoda, known as Chùa Hương. This stunning limestone landscape is filled with beautiful temples and caves, nestled in the Huong Son mountain range. One of the most popular activities here is taking a boat ride along the serene Yen Stream, leading you to the Thien Tru and Huong Tich temples.

For your visit, a round-trip package for adults to Huong Tich, which includes a ticket to the scenic area and a boat ride, costs 230,000 VND. If you prefer the convenience of a cable car, a return ticket is 260,000 VND. Please note that during the festival season, which takes place from the first to the third lunar month, boats operate from 4:00 AM to 8:00 PM. Outside this period, it's advisable to check the boat hours and rates locally, as they may vary.

The Perfume Pagoda is open daily from 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM, offering you ample time to explore its breathtaking surroundings. Make sure to take your time and enjoy the peaceful atmosphere here in this spiritual retreat.
